senses.gloss:
(उ) जमु r. 1st cl. (जमति)
To eat; also चम.

ind.
A wife. It is used in composition: see जम्पती.

m. (-ग्निः)
A Muni, the father of PARAŚURĀMA.

n. (-नं)
1 Eating.
2 Food, victuals.
E.
जम to eat, affix ल्युट्.

m. du. (-ती)
Husband and wife.
E.
जं for जाया a wife, and पति a husband: see दम्पती, &c.

mn. (-लः-लं)
1 Mud, clay.
2 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria,) &c.
m. (-लः)
A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
E.
जल water, बल to move, affix अण्, and the deriv. irr.

f. (-नी)
A river.
E.
जम्बाल mud, इनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-रः)
A lime: see the next.

m. (-रः)
1 Common lime, (Citrus acida); the name seems to be applied to more than one species.
2 A plant, called by some a sort of basil, with small leaves; also जम्भीर, and जम्बिर.
E.
जम to eat, ईरन् affix, and बुक् augment.

mn. (-म्बुः-म्बु)
1 Jambu Dvīpa, said to be so named from the Jambu tree abounding in it, and implying, according to the Purāṇas, the central division of the world, or the known world: according to the Bauddhas, it is confined to India.
2 A fabulous river, said to flow from the mountain Meru.
f. (-म्बुः)
A fruit tree, the rose apple, (Eugenia OK^1); also applied to every species of Eugenia.
fn. (-म्बुः-म्बु)
The fruit.
E.
जम to eat, बुक् augment, and कु or कू Uṇādi affix; hence it is also written जम्बूः.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-म्बूः)
See जम्बु.

m. (-कः)
1 A jackall.
2 The deity of water, VARUṆA.
3 A low man.
4 The rose apple.
E.
जम to eat, affix उकच् and वुक् augment, eating flesh, &c. or जम्बु as above, and कन् added; the affix also being ऊकच्, जम्बूक.

m. (-कः)
See जम्बुक.

m. (-पः)
One of the divisions of the world.
E.
द्वीप a continent, added to जम्बु.

m. (-मान्)
1 A monkey.
2 A mountain.
f. (-मती)
An Apsarā or heavenly nymph.

m. (-लः)
1 A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
2 The rose apple.
n. (-लं)
Jokes addressed to the bridegroom by his female relatives and friends.
E.
जम्बू as above, and ल what gets or is.

f. (-का)
Compliments or jokes addressed to the bride and bridegroom.
E.
जम्बूल, and मालिका a string.

m. (-म्भः)
1 A tooth.
2 The lime.
3 Food, victuals.
4 The chin.
5 A quiver.
6 A part, a portion.
7 The name of a demon.
E.
जभि to destroy, affix अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Who or what yawns, opens, expands, &c.
2 Who or what kills or destroys.
m. (-कः)
A lime or citron.
f. (-का)
Yawning.
E.
जभि to yawn, &c. ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-द्विट्)
A name of INDRA.
2 A demon.
E.
जम्भ a demon, and द्विष् a foe; also similar compounds.

m. (-दी)
INDRA.
E.
जम्भ as above, and भेदिन् destroying: see the last.

m. (-रः)
A lime or citron.
E.
see the next, ल being changed to र.

m. (-लः)
1 A lime or citron.
2 A Jina or deified Jaina saint.
f. (-ला)
A female Rākṣasī, the worship of whom is supposed to procure for women procreation.
E.
जभि to destroy, (sickness, sin, &c.) कलच् aff.

m. (-रिः)
1 INDRA'S thunderbolt.
2 Fire or its deity.
3 INDRA.
E.
जम्भ the demon, and अरि a foe.

m. (-म्भी)
A lime or citron.
E.
जभि to destroy, (disease,) affix इनि.

m. (-रः)
1 The lime or citron, apparently of more than one species.
2 A plant, considered to be a kind of basil with small leaves.
E.
जभि to destroy, (sickness,) ईरन् affix, and नुम् augment; also जम्बीर, &c.

m. (-ग्न्यः)
A name of PARAŚURĀMA.
E.
जमदग्नि a Muni so named, and यञ् patronymick affix; the son of the saint JAMADAGNI.

m. (-ता)
1 A daughter's husband, a son-in-law.
2 A husband, a lord or master.
3 A friend.
4 The sunflower, (Helianthus annuus.)
E.
जा for जाया a wife, मा to take, तृच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-मिः or मी)
1 A virtuous and respectable woman.
2 A sister, &c.
E.
जै to decline or decay, affix मि; or जम to eat, affix अण्, ङीप् optionally added.

m. (-यः)
A sister's son.
E.
जामि a sister, ढक् aff.

n. (-वं)
1 The rose apple, the fruit.
2 Gold.
E.
जम्बु the tree, अण् aff.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A cauterising needle or probe.

m. (-वान्)
A fabulous bear, father-in-law to KṚṢṆA.
E.
जाम्ब the Jambu tree, and मतुप् affix; also जाम्बुवत्.

n. (-दं)
Gold.
E.
जम्बुनदी a river flowing from mount Sumeru, the Indian Pactolus, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Golden, made of gold.
E.
जाम्बूनद and मयट् aff.
